items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: There was a young fellow by the name of Henry. Rando used to sing, very fine, very fine singer. He used to sing with him.

ctx.x: Jules Badouk played, he played banjo. And he had a very, very fine band. They played in the Little Club. That was many years ago. Had a very fine bunch of boys in that outfit. And of course, Ray played with him too. I think Monk played with him a whole lot. Yeah, Monk played with him there. But Jules was a very fine person. There was a young fellow by the name of Henry. Rando used to sing, very fine, very fine singer. He used to sing with him. Then Doc Rando, you know, he's... I think, did he graduate from…
He just didn't care about it.
